units.tag_basis: Scheme credits identifying the phospholipid on the membrane diagram.
units.difficulty_basis: Single-step recall from a labelled diagram.
units.summary: Pick the labelled component that is a phospholipid in a membrane diagram.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits a phospholipid having a hydrophobic tail of two fatty acids.
units.difficulty_basis: Direct recall of phospholipid structure.
units.summary: Choose the correct statement about phospholipid structure.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits a channel protein allowing polar or charged molecules to diffuse down a concentration gradient.
units.difficulty_basis: Applies knowledge of membrane proteins to a labelled diagram to describe a mechanism.
units.summary: Describe how a labelled membrane protein enables passive transport.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits an unchanged individual result, overlapping standard deviations and small sample size as reasons the conclusion is weak.
units.difficulty_basis: Routine interpretation of a table of means and standard deviations to judge a conclusion.
units.summary: Judge whether small-sample heart rate data back up a claimed effect of caffeine.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits widening the sample and controlling resting rate, age, sex and prior habits.
units.difficulty_basis: Evaluating and improving an experimental design.
units.summary: Suggest improvements to a human caffeine and heart rate trial.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits circle area from diameter then subtracting the aorta area.
units.difficulty_basis: Two-step calculation requiring the diameter-to-area conversion.
units.summary: Work out the difference in cross-sectional area between two vessels.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits thicker wall to withstand higher pressure or provide more elastic tissue.
units.difficulty_basis: Applies artery structure-function ideas to an unfamiliar animal.
units.summary: Explain a wall thickness difference between the same artery in two species.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits the reaction catalysed by thromboplastin (prothrombin to thrombin).
units.difficulty_basis: Direct recall of the clotting sequence.
units.summary: Select the reaction catalysed in blood clotting.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits calcium ions in the clotting process.
units.difficulty_basis: Direct recall.
units.summary: Identify the ions needed in blood clotting.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits reading ventricular systole from the pressure curves.
units.difficulty_basis: Reads the time period from a multi-trace graph.
units.summary: Pick the time window for ventricular contraction from pressure traces.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits semilunar closed and atrioventricular open at 1.0 s.
units.difficulty_basis: Interprets pressure relationships on the graph to infer valve states.
units.summary: Infer valve states at a given time from pressure traces.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits cycle length from the graph then 60 divided by it.
units.difficulty_basis: Routine calculation from a graph.
units.summary: Calculate heart rate from the duration of a cardiac cycle on a graph.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits a time at which the atrioventricular valves close.
units.difficulty_basis: Locates valve closure from pressure crossovers on the graph.
units.summary: Identify when the atrioventricular valve closes on the graph.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits valves closing to prevent backflow to the atria as the ventricle contracts.
units.difficulty_basis: Short explanation linking valve function to the cardiac cycle.
units.summary: Explain why a heart valve must shut during contraction.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits lower oxygen use in larger shrews because of smaller surface area to volume ratio and less heat loss.
units.difficulty_basis: Interprets a data trend and applies surface area to volume ideas.
units.summary: Explain the trend between body size and metabolic rate in shrews.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits rate multiplied by mass then by 24 hours.
units.difficulty_basis: Two-step calculation involving units conversion.
units.summary: Calculate daily oxygen use from a rate per gram per hour.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits mass of respiring cells and time affecting oxygen use so a valid comparison can be made.
units.difficulty_basis: Explains why rates are standardised.
units.summary: Explain why a rate is expressed per unit mass and time.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits large surface area, short diffusion distance and good blood supply in lungs.
units.difficulty_basis: Recall applied as an explanation.
units.summary: Explain how mammalian lungs suit efficient gas exchange.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits peptide as the bond joining amino acids.
units.difficulty_basis: Direct recall.
units.summary: Name the bond joining amino acids.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits water as a product and a correct dipeptide shown.
units.difficulty_basis: Applies condensation reaction to drawn structures.
units.summary: Draw the product of joining two amino acids.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits H as the R group of these amino acids.
units.difficulty_basis: Recognising structure from a diagram.
units.summary: Identify the variable group in the amino acid structures.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits vitamin C loss with cooking time supported by manipulated percentage figures from the graph.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits choosing cabbage for highest starting and retained vitamin C.
units.difficulty_basis: Reads data to reach a justified choice.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits the sources of cells and the needle and entry routes used in each test.

units.difficulty_basis: Explains implications and trade-offs for a scenario.

units.difficulty_basis: Six-mark levels response linking genetics, membrane transport and cardiovascular disease.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits dividing population by 500, halving for women then taking 30 percent.
units.difficulty_basis: Multi-step ratio and percentage calculation.
units.summary: Calculate how many women develop heart disease from an inherited condition.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits a treatment (gene therapy, antibiotic or physiotherapy) with a reason for its effect on lung symptoms.
units.difficulty_basis: Recall of treatments with explanation.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits altered amino acid sequence changing bonding and tertiary shape so the protein cannot transport chloride.
units.difficulty_basis: Links mutation to protein structure and function.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits choosing an interval on the straight portion, calculating change and giving the rate with units.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits a steeper initial gradient and a quicker plateau.
units.difficulty_basis: Predicts a modified curve from enzyme concentration changes.

units.tag_basis: Scheme credits DNA unwinding, template strand use, RNA polymerase and A-U base pairing.
units.difficulty_basis: Recall of transcription steps.
units.summary: Describe the role of transcription in making an enzyme.
